columns.name: dimension
columns.comment: Dimension: [Entity] The dimension field allows you to take different dimensional views of data over time. ARQ: Quarterly, excluding restatements, MRQ: Quarterly, including restatements, ARY: annual, excluding restatements, MRY: annual, including restatements, ART: trailing-twelve-months, excluding restatements, MRT: trailing-twelve-months, including restatements.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: calendardate
columns.comment: Calendar Date: [Entity] The Calendar Date represents the normalized [ReportPeriod]. This provides a common date to query for which is necessary due to irregularity in report periods across companies. For example, if the report period is 2015-09-26, the calendar date will be 2015-09-30 for quarterly and trailing-twelve-month dimensions (ARQ,MRQ,ART,MRT), and 2015-12-31 for annual dimensions (ARY,MRY). We also employ offsets in order to maximise comparability of the period across companies. For example consider two companies: one with a quarter ending on 2018-07-24, and the other with a quarter ending on 2018-06-28. A naive normalization process would assign these to differing calendar quarters of 2018-09-30 and 2018-06-30 respectively. However, we assign these both to the 2018-06-30 calendar quarter because this maximises the overlap in the report periods in question and therefore the comparability of this period.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: date
columns.comment: Date: [Entity] SEC filing date for AR dimensions (ARQ,ART,ARY), and [REPORTPERIOD] for MR dimensions (MRQ,MRT,MRY). Observation date for price-based fields (MarketCap, PE). Retail Sharadar name (formerly datekey).

columns.comment: Net Cash Flow from Financing: [Cash Flow Statement] A component of [NCF] representing the amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activities, from continuing and discontinued operations. Principal components of financing cash flow are: issuance (purchase) of equity shares, issuance (repayment) of debt securities, and payment of dividends & other cash distributions. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: ncfi
columns.comment: Net Cash Flow from Investing: [Cash Flow Statement] A component of [NCF] representing the amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activities, from continuing and discontinued operations. Principal components of investing cash flow are: capital (expenditure) disposal of equipment [CapEx], business (acquisitions) disposition [NCFBus] and investment (acquisition) disposal [NCFInv]. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: ncfinv
columns.comment: Net Cash Flow - Investment Acquisitions and Disposals: [Cash Flow Statement] A component of [NCFI] representing the net cash inflow (outflow) associated with the acquisition & disposal of investments, including marketable securities and loan originations. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: ncfo
columns.comment: Net Cash Flow from Operations: [Cash Flow Statement] A component of [NCF] representing the amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, from continuing and discontinued operations.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: ncfx
columns.comment: Effect of Exchange Rate Changes on Cash : [Cash Flow Statement] A component of Net Cash Flow [NCF] representing the amount of increase (decrease) from the effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalent balances held in foreign currencies. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: netinc
columns.comment: Net Income: [Income Statement] The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent after the deduction of [NetIncNCI] from [ConsolInc], and before the deduction of [PrefDivIS].
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: netinccmn
columns.comment: Net Income Common Stock: [Income Statement] The amount of net income (loss) for the period due to common shareholders. Typically differs from [NetInc] to the parent entity due to the deduction of [PrefDivIS].
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: netinccmnusd
columns.comment: Net Income Common Stock (USD): [Income Statement] [NetIncCmn] in USD, converted by [FXUSD].
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: netincdis
columns.comment: Net Loss Income from Discontinued Operations: [Income Statement] Amount of loss (income) from a disposal group, net of income tax, reported as a separate component of income. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: netincnci
columns.comment: Net Income to Non-Controlling Interests: [Income Statement] The portion of income which is attributable to non-controlling interest shareholders, subtracted from [ConsolInc] in order to obtain [NetInc]. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: netmargin
columns.comment: Profit Margin: [Metrics] Measures the ratio between a company\
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: opex
columns.comment: Operating Expenses: [Income Statement] Operating expenses represent the total expenditure on [SGnA], [RnD] and other operating expense items, it excludes [CoR].
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: opinc
columns.comment: Operating Income: [Income Statement] Operating income is a measure of financial performance before the deduction of [IntExp], [TaxExp] and other Non-Operating items. It is calculated as [GP] minus [OpEx].
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: payables
columns.comment: Trade and Non-Trade Payables: [Balance Sheet] A component of [Liabilities] representing trade and non-trade payables. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: payoutratio
columns.comment: Payout Ratio: [Metrics] The percentage of earnings paid as dividends to common stockholders. Calculated by dividing [DPS] by [EPSUSD].
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: pb
columns.comment: Price to Book Value: [Metrics] Measures the ratio between [MarketCap] and [EquityUSD].
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: pe
columns.comment: Price Earnings (Damodaran Method): [Metrics] Measures the ratio between [MarketCap] and [NetIncCmnUSD]
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: pe1
columns.comment: Price to Earnings Ratio: [Metrics] An alternative to [PE] representing the ratio between [Price] and [EPSUSD].
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: ppnenet
columns.comment: Property Plant & Equipment Net: [Balance Sheet] A component of [Assets] representing the amount after accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Includes Operating Right of Use Assets. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: prefdivis
columns.comment: Preferred Dividends Income Statement Impact: [Income Statement] Income statement item reflecting dividend payments to preferred stockholders. Subtracted from Net Income to Parent [NetInc] to obtain Net Income to Common Stockholders [NetIncCmn]. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: price
columns.comment: Share Price (Adjusted Close): [Entity] The price per common share adjusted for stock splits but not adjusted for dividends, used in the computation of [PE1], [PS1], [DivYield] and [SPS].
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: ps
columns.comment: Price Sales (Damodaran Method): [Metrics] Measures the ratio between [MarketCap] and [RevenueUSD].
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: ps1
columns.comment: Price to Sales Ratio: [Metrics] An alternative calculation method to [PS], that measures the ratio between a company\
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: receivables
columns.comment: Trade and Non-Trade Receivables: [Balance Sheet] A component of [Assets] representing trade and non-trade receivables. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: retearn
columns.comment: Accumulated Retained Earnings (Deficit): [Balance Sheet] A component of [Equity] representing the cumulative amount of the entities undistributed earnings or deficit. May only be reported annually by certain companies, rather than quarterly.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: revenue
columns.comment: Revenues: [Income Statement] The amount of Revenue recognised from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Interest income for financial institutions is reported net of interest expense and provision for credit losses. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: revenueusd
columns.comment: Revenues (USD): [Income Statement] [Revenue] in USD, converted by [FXUSD]. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: rnd
columns.comment: Research and Development Expense: [Income Statement] A component of [OpEx] representing the aggregate costs incurred in a planned search or critical investigation aimed at discovery of new knowledge with the hope that such knowledge will be useful in developing a new product or service. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: roa
columns.comment: Return on Average Assets: [Metrics] Return on assets measures how profitable a company is [NetIncCmn] relative to its total assets [AssetsAvg].
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: roe
columns.comment: Return on Average Equity: [Metrics] Return on equity measures a corporation\
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: roic
columns.comment: Return on Invested Capital: [Metrics] Return on Invested Capital is a ratio estimated by dividing [EBIT] by [InvCapAvg]. [InvCap] is calculated as: [Debt] plus [Assets] minus [Intangibles] minus [CashnEq] minus [LiabilitiesC]. Please note this calculation method is subject to change.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: ros
columns.comment: Return on Sales: [Metrics] Return on Sales is a ratio to evaluate a company\
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: sbcomp
columns.comment: Share Based Compensation: [Cash Flow Statement] A component of [NCFO] representing the total amount of noncash, equity-based employee remuneration. This may include the value of stock or unit options, amortization of restricted stock or units, and adjustment for officers\
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: sgna
columns.comment: Selling General and Administrative Expense: [Income Statement] A component of [OpEx] representing the aggregate total costs related to selling a firm\
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: sharefactor
columns.comment: Share Factor: [Entity] Share factor is a multiplicand in the calculation of [MarketCap] and is used to adjust for: American Depository Receipts (ADRs) that represent more or less than 1 underlying share, and, companies which have different earnings share for different share classes (eg Berkshire Hathaway - BRK.B).
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: sharesbas
columns.comment: Shares (Basic): [Entity] The number of shares or other units outstanding of the entity\
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: shareswa
columns.comment: Weighted Average Shares: [Income Statement] The weighted average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used by the company to calculate [EPS], determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: shareswadil
columns.comment: Weighted Average Shares Diluted: [Income Statement] The weighted average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used by the company to calculate [EPSDil], determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: sps
columns.comment: Sales per Share: [Metrics] Sales per Share measures the ratio between [RevenueUSD] and [SharesWA] as adjusted by [ShareFactor].
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: tangibles
columns.comment: Tangible Asset Value: [Metrics] The value of tangibles assets calculated as the difference between [Assets] and [Intangibles].
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: taxassets
columns.comment: Tax Assets: [Balance Sheet] A component of [Assets] representing tax assets and receivables. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: taxexp
columns.comment: Income Tax Expense: [Income Statement] Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: taxliabilities
columns.comment: Tax Liabilities: [Balance Sheet] A component of [Liabilities] representing outstanding tax liabilities. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: tbvps
columns.comment: Tangible Assets Book Value per Share: [Metrics] Measures the ratio between [Tangibles] and [SharesWA] as adjusted by [ShareFactor].
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: workingcapital
columns.comment: Working Capital: [Metrics] Working capital measures the difference between [AssetsC] and [LiabilitiesC].
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

Where a company is delisted and the ticker subsequently recycled for use by a different company, we utilise that ticker for the currently active company and append a number to the ticker of the delisted company. The ACTIONS table provides a record of historical ticker changes.

columns.comment: Transaction Date: If there has been a transaction, the date of the transaction is provided here.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: securityadcode
columns.comment: Security Acquired/Disposed Code: [D] Derivative, No Transaction [DA] Derivative Acquisition [DD] Derivative Disposition [N] Non-Derivative, No Transaction [NA] Non-Derivative Acquisition [ND] Non-Derivative Disposition
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: transactioncode
columns.comment: Transaction Code: The available [Transaction Codes] [Transaction Categories] Descriptions are as follows: [P] [General] Open market or private purchase of non-derivative or derivative security [S] [General] Open market or private sale of non-derivative or derivative security [V] [General] Transaction voluntarily reported earlier than required [A] [Rule 16b-3] Grant, award or other acquisition pursuant to Rule 16b-3(d) [D] [Rule 16b-3] Disposition to the issuer of issuer equity securities pursuant to Rule 16b-3(e) [F] [Rule 16b-3] Payment of exercise price or tax liability by delivering or withholding securities [I] [Rule 16b-3] Discretionary transaction in accordance with Rule 16b-3(f) [M] [Rule 16b-3] Exercise or conversion of derivative security exempted pursuant to Rule 16b-3 [C] [Derivative Codes] Conversion of derivative security [E] [Derivative Codes] Expiration of short derivative position [H] [Derivative Codes] Expiration (or cancellation) of long derivative position with value received [O] [Derivative Codes] Exercise of out-of-the-money derivative security [X] [Derivative Codes] Exercise of in-the-money or at-the-money derivative security [G] [Other Section 16(b) Exempt] Bona fide gift [L] [Other Section 16(b) Exempt] Small acquisition under Rule 16a-6 [W] [Other Section 16(b) Exempt] Acquisition or disposition by will or the laws of descent and distribution [Z] [Other Section 16(b) Exempt] Deposit into or withdrawal from voting trust [J] [Other] Other acquisition or disposition [K] [Other] Transaction in equity swap or instrument with similar characteristics [U] [Other] Disposition pursuant to a tender of shares in a change of control transaction
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: sharesownedbeforetransaction
columns.comment: Shares Owned Before Transaction: The number of shares owned before the transaction.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: transactionshares
columns.comment: Transaction Shares: The number of shares transacted.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: sharesownedfollowingtransaction
columns.comment: Shares Owned Following Transaction: The number of shares owned following the transaction.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: transactionpricepershare
columns.comment: Transaction Price per Share: The transaction price per share.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: transactionvalue
columns.comment: Transaction Value: The value of the transaction.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: securitytitle
columns.comment: Security Title: The title of the class of security.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: directorindirect
columns.comment: Direct or Indirect?: Is the ownership held [D]irectly or [I]ndirectly?
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.name: natureofownership
columns.comment: Nature of Ownership: Where the ownership is held through an investment vehicle (trust, fund etc) the name of that investment vehicle is provided here.
columns.lineage_method: provider source-table column

columns.comment: Date Exercisable: The date that an option is exercisable, where applicable and available.

columns.comment: Price Exercisable: The price at which an option is exercisable, where applicable and available.
